one_at_a_time_assumption_sensitivity.meaning: local perturbation experiment on inferred inputs; values are not confidence intervals, empirical uncertainty bands, or retuned profiles

paired_propeller_inference.status: paired propeller load inference with ideal-power refusals; no propeller is physically calibrated or held out
paired_propeller_inference.method: Full-admission engine/propeller torque roots; runtime-matched blade-element surrogate; one measured OS 2T RPM anchor only.

actuator_disk_bound_method.decision: For positive thrust in forward flow, require surrogate shaft power to exceed this ideal momentum-theory lower bound by at least 5%. Roots below the ideal bound are physically impossible; roots below the 5% engineering margin are also rejected by this screen. Nonpositive-thrust and reverse-flow cases are outside this check.
actuator_disk_bound_method.scope: Independent inference/report audit only. This is not measured induced flow, propeller calibration, aircraft validation, or a runtime operating-limit implementation.

uncertainty_method.meaning: conservative paired assumptions combining profile efficiency/charge/loss sensitivity, air density and section coefficients. The reported min/max are scenario sensitivity envelopes, not probability intervals, confidence intervals or physical bounds.
